dt4 <-  dt3 %>% rowwise() %>% group_by ( iso,  year )  %>% 
  mutate( mean.ydr = min ( ydr )) %>% select(iso,  adm_id,  id,  year,  ydr,  mean.ydr)

ggplot(dt4 , aes(year, reorder(id, mean.ydr))) + geom_raster(aes(fill = ydr)) + 

scale_fill_distiller ( palette =  "Spectral" ) + scale_colour_distiller ( palette = "Spectral" )+

  facet_grid (iso ~ . , scales = "free", space = "free", margins = F)+

  theme(panel.spacing = unit( 0, "lines"))
